character.name: Cyrin Voss
character.background: Oathbroken Paladin / Falsely Accused Disgraced Noble
traits: Stoic Resolve: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened
Unyielding Honesty: Cannot knowingly tell a lie, even to protect oneself
Haunted by Treason: Advantage on Intelligence (History) checks related to the plot that framed him
Oathbroken Aura: Disadvantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks with devout followers of his former deity
character.gear: Dented steel plate armor · Notched longsword · Steel shield · 3 days of dried ironweed rations · Tarnished silver holy symbol of the Dawn Father · 50 ft hempen rope · Flint and tinder · Blood-stained letter of royal accusation
character.story: Cyrin Voss was the youngest knight of the Dawn Order, beloved by his liege, until the night the royal treasury was breached and his sword was found at the scene. Falsely accused by three envious lords, he was stripped of his title, divine favor, and honor, forced to flee as his squire was executed for aiding him. Now he wanders the borderlands, his oath broken, his heart heavy with guilt, seeking proof to clear his name, or vengeance to restore his honor.

inventory.name: Notched longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for Cyrin’s knighthood ceremony, gifted by his liege lord. The notch in the blade came from the duel where he was accused of striking a fellow knight, a blow he never dealt.
inventory.description: Dented steel longsword, the Voss crest on the crossguard is half-scratched off.

inventory.name: Dented steel plate armor
inventory.lore: Ancestral plate passed down through three generations of House Voss. The dent on the breastplate was made in the ambush that framed Cyrin for treason, a wound he never treated.
inventory.description: Heavy, dented steel plate armor, still serviceable despite its damage.

inventory.name: Steel shield
inventory.lore: Bears the Voss family crest, now defaced with a traitor’s mark branded into the steel by the court that convicted Cyrin.
inventory.description: Dented steel round shield, branded with the mark of a convicted traitor.

inventory.name: Tarnished silver holy symbol of the Dawn Father
inventory.lore: Gifted to Cyrin when he took his paladin’s oath. It has not glowed with divine power since his vow was broken, a constant reminder of his failure.
inventory.description: Sunburst-shaped holy symbol made of tarnished silver, cold to the touch.
inventory.effects: Can serve as a divine spellcasting focus if Cyrin ever regains his oath’s power.

inventory.name: Dried ironweed rations
inventory.lore: Ironweed is a bitter, hardy plant that grows in the northern moors of Cyrin’s homeland. These were packed by his sister before he left for the capital.
inventory.description: Dried, bitter leaves that provide a day’s sustenance, tasting of ash and regret.
inventory.effects: Consuming one portion grants resistance to poison for 1 hour, but imposes disadvantage on Charisma checks for 1 hour due to their acrid taste.

inventory.name: 50 ft hempen rope
inventory.lore: Used to lower Cyrin’s squire from the castle walls the night he fled the capital, a secret he has never revealed to anyone.
inventory.description: Sturdy hempen rope, frayed at one end from use.

inventory.name: Flint and tinder
inventory.lore: Stolen from the castle armory the night Cyrin escaped, it has kept him warm through countless cold nights on the run.
inventory.description: Standard flint and steel set, wrapped in oilcloth to keep it dry.

inventory.name: Blood-stained letter of royal accusation
inventory.lore: The official court document that stripped Cyrin of his title and declared him a traitor. The bloodstain is from his squire, executed for aiding Cyrin’s escape.
inventory.description: Parchment letter sealed with the royal crest, smeared with dried blood.
inventory.effects: Cyrin can recall the names of the three lords who testified against him by reading this letter, a memory he has replayed a thousand times.
